title: pleno-dlp crash report
description: Wire contract between the pleno-dlp client (pkg/telemetry/crash) and the plenoai.com crash relay (workers/crash-relay). This file is the single source of truth: the Go Report struct and the relay's validate() are both asserted against its property allowlist by tests on either side.

schema.description: Contract identifier. The relay rejects any other value.

fingerprint.description: 16 hex chars of SHA-256 over the digit-normalized message and the top in-module function names; groups crashes by cause across versions.

commit.description: pleno-dlp build commit (GoReleaser main.commit); empty when unknown.

go_version.description: Go runtime version that produced the report (runtime.Version()).

command.description: Redacted subcommand words that panicked, e.g. scan filesystem. Never positional arguments.

flags.description: Names of recognised flags only, never values.

kind.description: How the crash was captured: panic/fatal observed by the supervisor, recovered caught in-process.

message.description: Redacted panic or fatal-error line. Scanned file content and secrets MUST NOT appear here; the relay rejects any key outside this allowlist so a client cannot smuggle them in.

stack.description: Redacted goroutine dump, module-relative and capped by the client.

created_at.description: When the crash was captured, RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 in UTC, truncated to the minute.
